🎥🎬: Twisted Metal (2023)
In a world where civilization has collapsed and the highways belong to killers, John Doe takes on a dangerous mission that could change his life forever. As a delivery driver navigating a wasteland filled with armed vehicles and unpredictable enemies, every mile brings him closer to either his reward or his grave.
His journey takes a wild turn when he teams up with Quiet, an independent outlaw who can handle herself in a fight. But surviving the wasteland means facing terrifying threats, including Sweet Tooth, a masked killer with a deadly ice cream truck and absolutely no chill.
With explosive car chases, brutal shootouts, and ridiculous dark comedy, Twisted Metal transforms every road trip into a fight for survival.
Twisted Metal is now streaming on Peacock. #SonyPicsPartner
